text:
sara (marketing): Quick kickoff — bicoastal marketplace + webinar + blog sprint. Goal: list in AWS & GCP marketplaces, run a 45-min joint webinar, and publish a benchmark narrative with three micro-case benchmarks. Timeline: 4 weeks. Need owners for: marketplace listings, webinar logistics, benchmark data, blog copy, inbound routing. @amy (partnerships) can you lead marketplace listing? @kevin (content) will you own the benchmark blog? @lia (events) handle webinar ops? Need HubSpot routing mapped to east/west SDR queues. Draft brief (WIP): https://redwood-inference.example/briefs/bicoastal-launch

amy (partnerships): I'm in. I have the checklist from the last partner launch — should speed things up. Can reuse a bunch of listing assets but will need the vendor contacts for GCP marketplace. @alex (demand) can you share the contact?

alex (demand): I have the GCP PM contact and can intro by EOD. For inbound routing, recommend a HubSpot list called `marketplace-inbound` + IP/geo split to assign east/west SDRs. Also propose a Drift playbook for live clicks from the listing.

kevin (content): Will take the blog + benchmark. Proposed micro-benchmarks: 1) e-comm search relevance (rerank), 2) multi-turn chat SLAs (latency/accuracy), 3) embeddings rerank cost/latency. Estimate ~1.5 eng-days per bench to reproduce perf + notes. Need runtime metrics and token-cost breakdown from eng-runtime. Draft outline link: https://docs.google.com/xxx

daniel (gTM): I can coordinate perf runs with eng-runtime. We'll capture latency p50/p95, throughput, and cost-per-1k tokens vs baseline. Recommend a tiny table with numbers + callouts on batching and quantization choices.

lia (events): Webinar ops: target Wed May 18 11am PT / 2pm ET. Format: 5m intro (Sara), 10m partner story (Amy), 15m demo (Kevin), 10m eng runtime + perf (Daniel), 10m live Q&A. Need slide deck + speaker notes one week prior. Dry run Friday May 13. Ordering: Zoom webinar, record + captions, live poll for attendees. I'll block calendar invites.

sara (marketing): Love this. CTA for the blog + webinar: "Try in marketplace" deep link + 2-week free trial coupon. Webinar follow-up nurture: 1) Recording + TL;DR, 2) Short benchmark highlights + link to blog, 3) Demo scheduling CTA that goes to SDR booking. Also let's gate the benchmark assets via a lightweight form for lead capture.

alex (demand): For inbound routing specifics: integrate listing CTA -> HubSpot form -> set property `lead_source=marketplace` + `region=E/W` then webhook to SDR queue. For Drift, route listing visitors to the "marketplace" playbook that offers booking a demo or downloading the benchmark. We'll set lead score + SLA (24h).

kevin (content): Example reproduction command I'll include in repo: `rcli run-bench --model open-redwood-1 --scenario rerank --tokens 512` (placeholder — will replace with CI-backed scripts once eng-runtime finishes runs). Will also include a short code snippet showing embedding + rerank.

amy (partnerships): I'll start building the marketplace listing assets. Do we have GCP-specific imagery or do we use the generic brand pack? @sara (marketing) can you share the brand asset pack and the short PR quote we want partners to use?

sara (marketing): Uploaded the brand pack + sample PR quote to the brief link. Also added suggested social copy and sample CTAs. If partner wants an embargoed PR, flag here and we'll coordinate with comms.

daniel (gTM): Quick POV — I don't think a formal press release is necessary for this one. Suggest a coordinated social + blog + webinar push, with partner amplification. We should, however, prepare a short partner FAQ for any press questions.

lia (events): I'll set up the dry-run invite and run recording ops checklist. Who owns editing the recording into clips for social and blog embed? @kevin?

kevin (content): Yep I'll edit a 90–120s highlight + pull full transcript for blog captions. Need access to transcript (auto-captions ok) and the recording raw file.

sara (marketing): Action items recap: Amy — marketplace assets & vendor contacts; Alex — GCP intro + inbound routing setup; Kevin — benchmark blog, code snippets, webinar edits; Lia — webinar ops, dry run, recording; Daniel — perf runs + cost numbers. I'll spin up a shared taskboard and calendar invites after this thread. Target public launch date: 2026-05-20. :rocket:
